syllabusSource.title: PCI Education Regulations 2020 (ER-2020) D.Pharm syllabus, Pharmacognosy ER20-13T and ER20-13P (university copy, Gurukula Kangri Vishwavidyalaya)

units.title: Definition, history, present status and scope of Pharmacognosy
Alkaloids, terpenoids, glycosides, volatile oils, tannins and resins
Biological source, chemical constituents and therapeutic efficacy of crude drugs
Plant fibres used as surgical dressings; sutures
Basic principles of traditional systems of medicine
Role of medicinal and aromatic plants in national economy and their export potential

practicals.title: Morphology of seeds and fruits: Ispaghula, Coriander, Fennel, Cardamom, Nutmeg, Black Pepper, Gokhru
Morphology of leaves, flower buds and herbs: Senna, Clove, Ephedra, Punarnava
Morphology of barks, underground parts and agar: Cinnamon, Cinchona, Ginger, Rauwolfia, Agar
Transverse section of leaves: Datura and Vasaka
Transverse section of fruits and seeds: Ajwain, Coriander and Nux-vomica
Transverse section of barks: Cinnamon and Cinchona
Transverse section of roots, stolons and rhizomes: Ashwagandha, Liquorice and Curcuma
Physical and chemical tests: Acacia, Tragacanth, Agar, Guar gum and Gelatine
Physical and chemical tests: Asafoetida and Benzoin
Physical and chemical tests: Pale catechu and Black catechu
Physical and chemical tests: Castor oil
